correctness.rationale: All geometric nodes follow from explicit characteristic-five gradient equations and a nondegenerate Hessian. The minimal resolution is a K3 surface and differs in rational-point counts by sixteen rational exceptional conics. Exhaustive standard-library enumeration over F5 and F25 yields 16 and 776. The K3 trace of Frobenius squared is the maximal 22 times 25; purity forces eigenvalues ±5, of multiplicities 18 and 4, yielding every finite-extension formula and zeta factorization. Finite verification is distinguished from the infinite cohomological argument.

value.rationale: The selected fiber is not arbitrary: it is the reduction at five of Edge/Maschke’s symmetric quartic, and it develops the maximal possible sixteen ordinary nodes. Its K3 resolution attaining the Weil bound over F25 and having a completely explicit nontrivial ±5 Frobenius spectrum is a meaningful exact arithmetic invariant relevant to exceptional reduction and Kummer K3 geometry. The arithmetic result is not merely a rephrasing of known general Kummer-locus equations.
